title: Infostealer suspicious LOLBin execution from user-writable path (step 1 of 3)
author: Adama ASSIONGBON (SOC & CTI Consultant), https://linkedin.com/in/adama-assiongbon-9029893a
description: Step 1 of correlated infostealer detection: suspicious LOLBin or loader execution from user-writable paths. Use this rule as the first stage for correlation with credential-store access (step 2) and external egress (step 3). Alert alone has moderate confidence; chain all three for high-confidence infostealer confirmation.
